questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 4 ∶ 5 and their HCF is 6. Their LCM is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of numbers = 4 ∶ 5, HCF = 6

**Concept:**

For any two numbers, Product of Numbers = Product of their HCF and LCM

**Calculation:**

⇒ First number = 4 × HCF = 4 × 6 = 24

⇒ Second number = 5 × HCF = 5 × 6 = 30

⇒ LCM = (First number × Second number)/HCF = (24 × 30)/6 = 120

**Therefore, the LCM of the two numbers is 120.**

questions.question: A toy is bought for Rs. 950 and sold at Rs. 1140. Find the gain percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price = ₹950,

Selling price = ₹1140

**Concept:**

Gain% = [(Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price] × 100%

**Calculation:**

⇒ Gain = Selling price - Cost price = ₹1140 - ₹950 = ₹190

⇒ Gain% = (Gain / Cost price) × 100%

⇒ (₹190 / ₹950) × 100% = 0.20 = 20%

**Therefore, the gain percentage is 20%.**

questions.question: ₹x were borrowed at the compound interest rate of 5% per annum, 3 years back, where interest were compounding annually. If the present value of the money borrowed is ₹18,522, what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Present value = ₹18522,

Interest rate = 5%,

Time = 3 years

**Concept:**

If the interest is compounded annually,

Present value = Principal × (1 + Rate/100)⁽Time⁾

**Calculation:**

⇒ Principal = Present value/((1 + Rate/100)⁽Time⁾)

⇒ ₹18522/((1 + 5/100)⁽³⁾) = ₹16000

**Therefore, the value of x is ₹16000.**

questions.question: The total surface area of a hemisphere of diameter 14 cm is (Use π = (22)/(7)):
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the hemisphere = 14 cm

**Concept:**

The total surface area of a hemisphere = 3πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Radius = Diameter/2 = 14/2 = 7 cm

⇒ Total surface area = 3πr² = 3 × 22/7 × (7²) = 462 cm²

**Therefore, the total surface area of the hemisphere is 462 cm².**

questions.question: Reeta can do a piece of work in 14 days and Geeta can do the same work in 21 days. How many days Reeta and Geeta take together to complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Reeta can do the work in 14 days,

Geeta can do the work in 21 days

**Concept:**

If two people are working together, then 1/(Total work) = 1/(Reeta's work) + 1/(Geeta's work)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 1/(Total work) = 1/14 + 1/21 = 5/42

⇒ Total work = 42/5 = 8.4 days

**Therefore, Reeta and Geeta together can complete the work in 8.4 days.**

questions.question: Find the greatest number which on dividing 1780 and 2452 leaves the remainder 4 in each case.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two numbers 1780 and 2452, Remainder = 4

**Concept:**

The greatest number which on dividing given numbers leaves the same remainder is their HCF.

**Calculation:**

⇒ The new numbers after adjusting for the same remainder = 1780 - 4 = 1776 and 2452 - 4 = 2448

⇒ HCF of 1776 and 2448 is 48

**Therefore, the greatest number that on dividing 1780 and 2452 leaves the remainder 4 in each case is 48.**

questions.question: If the price of petrol is increased by 40%, by what percentage (rounded off to 1 decimal place) should its consumption be decreased so that the expenditure on petrol remains the same?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Increase in price = 40%

**Concept:**

If the expenditure is to remain the same, Percentage decrease in consumption = (Increase in price/(100 + Increase in price)) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage decrease in consumption = (40/(100 + 40)) × 100 = 28.6%

**Therefore, consumption should be decreased by 28.6% to keep the expenditure the same.**

questions.question: The total surface area of a cuboid is 4200 cm². If the length and breadth of the cuboid are 15 cm and 16 cm, then find the height of the cuboid.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for height when TSA, length (l), and breadth (b) are given:

Height = (TSA ÷ 2 − l × b) ÷ (l + b)

Height = (4200 ÷ 2 − 15 × 16) ÷ (15 + 16)

Height = (2100 − 240) ÷ 31 = 1860 ÷ 31 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f0c82f5bf514b53c9e89252b5c795a92054d29f4be3e07a2303f5fcc6c3f235.png] 

**Given:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 4200 cm²

Length (l) = 15 cm

Breadth (b) = 16 cm

**Formula Used:**

TSA of a cuboid = 2(l × b + b × h + h × l)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4200 = 2(15 × 16 + 16 × h + h × 15)

⇒ 2100 = 240 + 16h + 15h

⇒ 2100 = 240 + 31h

⇒ 31h = 2100 − 240

⇒ 31h = 1860

⇒ h = 1860 ÷ 31 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as: Volume = l × b × h

Lateral Surface Area

The area of the four side walls excluding top and bottom: LSA = 2h(l + b)

Length of Diagonal

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cuboid: Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²)

questions.question: In a golf club, 90% of members are men and the remaining are women. The average height of men is 170 cm and the average height of women is 165 cm. Find the average height of the club members.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

90% are men,

Average height of men = 170 cm,

Average height of women = 165 cm

**Concept:**

Overall average = (sum of all values)/(total number of values)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Average height = 0.9 × 170 + 0.1 × 165 = 169.5 cm

**Therefore, the average height of the club members is 169.5 cm.**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 18 days. B can do this work in 24 days. A started the work alone. After how many days should B join him, so that the work is finished in 15 days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 18 days,

B can do the same work in 24 days,

Work is finished in 15 days

**Concept:**

Work done = Time × Work rate

**Calculation:**

Let the total work = LCM(18, 24) = 72 units

So,

Efficiency of A = 72/18 = 4 units

Efficiency of B = 72/24 = 3 units

A starts the work, so A works for 15 days.

So,

Work completed by A = 15 × 4 = 60 units

So,

Work completed by B = 72 - 60 = 12 units

So,

B works for = 12/3 = 4 days

So,

B joins the work after = 15 - 4 = 11 days

**Therefore, B should join A after 11 days.**

questions.question: Find the distance covered by a car moving at a speed of 48 km/h for 3 hours 15 minutes.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed = 48 km/h,

Time = 3 hours 15 minutes = 3.25 hours

**Concept:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance = 48 km/h × 3.25 hours = 156 km

**Therefore, the distance covered by the car is 156 km.**

questions.question: Successive discounts of 10%, 15% and 4% on ₹12,500 are equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Successive discounts of 10%, 15% and 4% on ₹12,500

**Concept:**

Successive discount = Original price × (1 - discount1/100) × (1 - discount2/100) × (1 - discount3/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount = ₹12,500 × (1 - 10/100) × (1 - 15/100) × (1 - 4/100) = ₹9180

⇒ Discount = ₹12,500 - ₹9180 = ₹3320

**Therefore, the successive discounts on ₹12,500 is ₹3320.**

questions.question: After giving a discount of 25 percent, selling price of an article becomes Rs. 9510. What is the marked price of the article ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price after 25% discount = Rs. 9510

**Concept:**

Marked price = Selling price/(1 - discount %)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Marked price = 9510/(1 - 0.25) = Rs. 12680

**Therefore, the marked price of the article is Rs. 12680.**

questions.question: By selling a commodity for Rs. 15,000, Subir loses Rs. 2,000. What is his percentage loss?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price = Rs. 15,000, Loss = Rs. 2,000

**Concept:**

Loss percentage = (Loss/Cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost price = Selling price + Loss

⇒ Rs. 15,000 + Rs. 2,000 = Rs. 17,000

⇒ Loss percentage = (Rs. 2,000/Rs. 17,000) × 100 = 11.7647%, which can be approximated as 11(13)/(17)\%

**Therefore, the percentage loss is 11(13)/(17)\%.**

questions.question: The average marks in geography exam of a class of 25 students are 64. If the marks of three students were misread as 44, 46 and 61 in lieu of the actual marks 54, 64 and 67 respectively, then find the correct average
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Incorrect average marks = 64,

Number of students = 25,

Incorrect marks = 44, 46, 61;

Correct marks = 54, 64, 67

**Concept:**

Correct average = (Sum of correct marks/Total number of students)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of incorrect marks = 25 × 64 = 1600

⇒ Sum of correct marks = Sum of incorrect marks - Sum of incorrect individual marks + Sum of correct individual marks

⇒ = 1600 - (44 + 46 + 61) + (54 + 64 + 67) = 1634

⇒ Correct average = 1634 / 25 = 65.36

**Therefore, the correct average is 65.36.**

questions.question:
What will be the difference in the compound interest if a sum of Rs. 12,000 is compounded annually and half-yearly at an annual rate of 10% for a period of 2 years?

**Note:** Round off the decimal to the nearest number.
questions.solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 12,000

Rate = 10% per annum

Time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P × (1 + (r)/(n))ⁿt

Where, P = Principal, r = Rate, t = time(in years)

n = Number of times interest credited per year

**Calculation:**

For interest compounded annually, n = 1

Amount = 12000 × (1 + (10)/(100))²

⇒ Amount = 12000 × (110/100)2

⇒ Amount = 12000 × (11/10)2 = 14520

⇒ CI = 14520 - 12000 = 2520

For interest compounded half yearly, n = 2

Amount = 12000 × (1 + (10)/(2 × 100))2×2

⇒ Amount = 12000 × (1 + (5)/(100))4

⇒ Amount = 12000 × (105/100)4 = 14586.075 ≈ 14586

⇒ CI = 14586 - 12000 = 2586

Difference in CI = 2586 - 2520 = 66 rupees

**∴ The difference in CI is 66 rupees.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Concept:**

Compound Interest difference = P[(1 + r/2n)⁽²ⁿt⁾ - (1 + r/n)⁽ⁿt⁾]

**Calculation:**

⇒ Difference = Rs. 12,000[(1 + 0.1/4)⁽⁴²⁾ - (1 + 0.1/2)⁽²²⁾] = Rs. 66 (approximately)

∴ The difference in CI is 66 rupees.

questions.question: Teena spends 30% of her salary on food, 30% of the rest on fuel and saves the remaining Rs. 4,900. What is Teena's salary?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Teena spends 30% of salary on food,

30% of the rest on fuel,

Savings = Rs. 4900

**Concept:**

Total income = Expense + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Salary = Rs. 4900/[1 - 0.3 - 0.3(1 - 0.3)] = Rs. 10,000

**Therefore, Teena's salary is Rs. 10,000.**
